description: Stops an experiment with a reason. Nothing is deleted: schedule, seed and log stay, and analyze_experiment still analyzes what was logged up to the stop date, flagged exploratory. A stop cannot be undone (destructive); a stopped experiment accepts no more day logs and no longer blocks a new one on the same metric. An experiment past its last day cannot be stopped (analyze it). Stopping twice changes nothing. Local file only.
name: stop_experiment
title: Stop an experiment (nothing is deleted, but it cannot be restarted)
